message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine applicable crimes under Chinese criminal law.

Facts: Defendant Liu bought disabled persons' personal info 25,751 entries and phone, bank cards etc. Then used info to call, pretended to be civil affairs bureau and disabled persons subsidy center staff, to defraud victims (Hou, Gu) of 302,840 yuan transferred to accounts named "Yang", "Liu". So crimes: (1) Fraud (诈骗罪) – defrauding others of money by false pretenses. (2) Illegal acquisition of personal information – "非法获取公民个人信息罪" (under the Cybersecurity Law and Criminal Law article 253-2). Also possibly "侵犯公民个人信息罪". In Chinese law, the crime is "非法获取公民个人信息罪" (Article 253-2 of Criminal Law). Also possibly "诈骗罪" (fraud). The question: "只写这部分事实直接支持的罪名". So we list both: 诈骗罪;非法获取公民个人信息罪.

Check if there is also "敲诈勒索罪"? No, they used deception, not threat. So fraud.

Thus answer format: [罪名]诈骗罪;非法获取公民个人信息罪<eoa>

Make sure Chinese characters correct. Use semicolon.
